title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 2: The Value of Sustained Reading in a Distracted Age
prompt: In many countries, people now spend far more time scrolling through short online posts and videos than reading longer texts such as books, in-depth articles or reports. Some commentators argue that this shift is damaging our ability to concentrate and to think deeply, while others believe that short-form digital content is simply a new and equally valuable way of learning. To what extent do you agree or disagree that the decline of sustained reading is a serious problem for individuals and society? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为雅思学术类写作 Task 2 模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请先花 2–3 分钟审题：圈出题目中的核心争议（持续阅读减少是否严重）、需要回应的立场（你同意或不同意的程度）以及必须覆盖的两个层面（个人与社会）。写作时请明确给出你的立场，并用 2–3 个理由或例子展开论证；避免只罗列观点而不解释因果。建议用 5 分钟列提纲、30 分钟写作、5 分钟检查，确保字数不少于 250 词，并注意段落之间的逻辑连接。
